description: Enforces the operator-decision rule at the two boundaries where it is broken: a tracker write that hands over or files a decision without the whole record, and a turn that ends having handed the operator a decision in prose. Both read the rule out of the project's own constitution and refuse nothing in a project whose constitution has no operator-decision section. They are not free there: each is a python3 process, measured at ~17 ms on every Bash call and every turn end, in every project, adopted or not. Run `python3 <plugin>/hooks/check-od-record.py --explain` in a directory to see whether it is gated and by which file.
